description: This file contains utility functions for IP address manipulation, validation, and string validation, intended for reuse across web pages in a project.

methods.name: ip4StrToBin
methods.description: Converts an IPv4 address string to its binary representation as an integer.

methods.name: ip4BinToStr
methods.description: Converts a binary IPv4 address (integer) back to its string form.

methods.name: ip4MaskNum
methods.description: Calculates the subnet mask length from a binary mask.

methods.name: isIp4ValidInSubnet
methods.description: Checks if a binary IPv4 address is valid within a given subnet.

methods.name: isValidIp6Str
methods.description: Validates whether a string is a valid IPv6 address.

methods.name: ValidIp4Addr
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address is within a subnet and not reserved for network/broadcast addresses.
